milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange_concrete_powder wall is centered at spawn-relative (5, 1, 0) — a 5-wide × 4-tall wall at x=+5 from spawn. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range since the wall is only 5 blocks from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the orange wall rather than facing away.

Uses inventory_has because mining orange_concrete_powder drops the block itself as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. Orange concrete powder is not in the player's starting inventory (only a wooden pickaxe is given), so having at least 1 in inventory confirms successful mining. Preferred over position-based rules per the mining task preference order.

Uses inventory_has because mining stone_bricks with a pickaxe drops stone_bricks as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player has a wooden pickaxe (mining level 0) which is sufficient for stone-tier blocks. Stone bricks are not in the starting inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This task requires first mining through the orange concrete powder wall to access the stone_bricks behind it.
